 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Sports Sports Here's why Calvin Oftana and Carl Tamayo are out for Gilas' FIBA World Cup Qualifiers 5th window 
 By BEA MICALLER , GMA News Published November 11, 2026 2:13pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Calvin Oftana (photo: FIBA) and Carl Tamayo (photo: Vyn Radovan) of Gilas Pilipinas. Gilas Pilipinas will be without two core players for its upcoming FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers fifth window campaign with Calvin Oftana and Carl Tamayo both sitting out the tournament.
 National team head coach Tim Cone revealed that Oftana begged off from the fifth window as his wife is expected to give birth around the time Gilas plays its two games against Syria and Iran in Malaysia.
 Oftana last played in the tournament during the second window, where Gilas lost to both New Zealand and Australia. The TNT gunner, though, was part of the Gilas team that saw action in the Asian Games in Japan.
 "Calvin has begged off. His wife is delivering at the end of the month right during that time so he begged off and couldn't make it. But he was part of the original group," Cone revealed.

 Tamayo, who has suited up in seven of Gilas’ eight games in the qualifiers, will also miss the fifth window due to a sprained ankle. To recall, Tamayo suffered the injury during the third quarter of their 82-81 overtime win against Jordan last August 28 and was sidelined in their 68-56 win over Iran on August 30.
 "Carl is out with a badly sprained ankle. He and KQ are always the two first guys to text me and tell me. They're always the first two," Cone said.
 "But Carl texted me this time and said that his sprain this time is worse than it was when he got sprained in the window."
 With the two out, Cone and the Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas have added into the mix Rhenz Abando and Quentin Millora-Brown alongside the debuting Bennie Boatwright.
 Completing the roster are Juan Gomez de Liaño, Chris Newsome, Dwight Ramos, Kevin Quiambao, CJ Perez, Scottie Thompson, Mike Phillips, Kai Sotto, and AJ Edu.
 Gilas, currently sporting an even 4-4 card, will open the fifth window against Syria on November 27 before taking on powerhouse Iran on the 29th.
 —JMB, GMA News
